mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 73, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: snow_ston: a stone under a cap of snow.
why_this_one: 32 of them: snow-capped stones, and a seat.
effects_note: CreateOperate (ZzzObject.cpp :4682-4690, type 73): a character sits on it -- MOVEMENT_OPERATE's plain sit, no turn. terrain.py OPERABLE_BY_MAP[2] keeps its tile open. No light or blend.
